# Runtime and dependency notices

The unmodified `harlowe-3.3.9.js` is the official Twine-distributed Harlowe 3.3.9 story format by Leon Arnott. Its own metadata declares the Zlib license. Its original embedded es6-shim and jQuery notices are retained in the runtime and generated HTML. The game's original passages and stylesheet are separate from that runtime.

Runtime URL: https://twinery.org/2/story-formats/harlowe-3.3.9/format.js

SHA-256: 803a0d9d4fb8c3c1c99eaf16f37db6feaad72e36fc7e5f6c5a168465419895f3

Harlowe source: https://foss.heptapod.net/games/harlowe (automated source-license retrieval was blocked by its anti-bot page; this build retains the distributed metadata and all embedded notices).

## Embedded dependencies

- jQuery 3.7.1: MIT. Exact release license retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jquery/jquery/3.7.1/LICENSE.txt and saved as `jquery-LICENSE.txt`.
- es6-shim 0.35.4: MIT. Harlowe preserves the original notice identifying Copyright 2013-2016 Paul Miller and contributors. A supplementary current upstream copy of the MIT terms is saved as `es6-shim-LICENSE.txt`, from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/es-shims/es6-shim/master/LICENSE. Its 2019 copyright line is the current file's line, not a claim about the older embedded version; attempted historical URLs returned 404. The original notice remains in the distributed runtime.

Twine editor assets used solely for import/export testing are not distributed in this review package. No remote assets are needed to play the game.
